source.prompt: Create a landing page for Patchboard, scheduling software specifically for independent tattoo studios. Named founding team with backgrounds in tattooing. Features specific to tattooing (flash sheet booking, touch-up queue, deposit collection). Non-round per-chair pricing. Real integrations list. Founding story. Specific customer studio names.

notes: Hyper-niche SaaS for tattoo studios only. Founders: Nadia Osei (former studio owner, ran Void & Veil Tattoo Shoreditch) and Callum Rennie (ex-tattooist turned developer, former Treatwell). Pricing is £19/month per chair — non-round, niche-justified. Features only make sense for tattoo studios: flash sheet booking, touch-up queue, per-artist chair scheduling. Integrations: Stripe, Google Calendar, Mailchimp, Instagram DMs, WhatsApp Business, Xero. Named fictitious studios: Void & Veil Tattoo (Shoreditch), Inkmother Studio (Manchester), Fernwood Collective (Edinburgh), Static Needle (Bristol). Registered company 15128043, VAT 423 8891 17. Explicitly says 'We don't want to expand into nail salons'. [v1 calibration] businessSpecificity lower range because v1 rules target physical-world credentials (Gas Safe, SRA, CIF); VAT/company-reg detection added in future rules.
